answer: An extended-validation certificate makes each extra identity pay $390 a year; a farm running N fakes pays N×$390 and cannot share it because one certificate covers one entity, one domain, and one phone. One company record filed for 50 certificates dies by D-U-N-S check at 2: the second flags the same number and voids both. The callback reaches the office on the filing, a juniper hedge by its door; each application enters through one inlet where an agent reads the record back at the zenith of the check. A 500-seat farm pays $195,000 a year.
